products.name: Bosch Series 2 9 kg fully automatic top-load washing machine
products.summary: Lift the soft-closing glass lid and look down into the drum, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: Body only, 96 cm tall; with the lid open it is about 129 cm
specs: Smart, Water Save, Quick, Wool, Synthetics, Prewash, Delicates, Intense, Tub Clean, Spin
Water level (L01 to L10), Delay up to 24 h, Favorite, Soak, Wash Time, Rinse Cycle, Spin Time, Child Lock
Soft closing, hinged at the back, glass top
220-240 V, 50 Hz, 10 A fuse, India plug (6 A), 150 cm cord

hotspots.title: Soft Closing Lid
hotspots.text: It provides a gradual lid closure to ensure an injury-free and silent closing of the washer lid.

hotspots.title: Smart Program
hotspots.text: With the Smart program, the washing machine will automatically choose the optimum pattern and water level by sensing the load for your laundry cycle.

hotspots.title: 24h delay start
hotspots.text: Greater flexibility thanks to freely selectable program start delay (24 h).

hotspots.title: Inverter Motor
hotspots.text: The VarioInverter motor is a powerful, durable and highly efficient motor that provides optimum washing performance that is backed with warranty.
